title: Strength
description: Strength adds additional damage to Attacks.
notes: Stack-based power that modifies attack damage. Each stack of Strength adds that amount to damage dealt by the owner's powered attacks. Allows negative stacks (AllowNegative: true), which functions as a debuff reducing damage output. The smart description dynamically shows 'Increases' or 'Decreases' based on the current stack value and displays the absolute damage change.
